title: fix(studio): the action designer draws refusals and texts from their served rows
body:
Fixes #35650

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 在 Studio 里编辑脚本类操作时，整页编辑器和对象的"操作"视图把"拒绝目录"和"文本"两项从一大块原始 JSON 改成按条目编辑的表单，并带上说明文字；关联抽屉原本就是这样。
- 属于 Studio 操作设计器的补完：上一轮已经让服务端表单给这两项声明了逐条编辑的样式，这次让作者平时用的编辑器真正用上它。
- 出错时作者在这两项上会看到原来的 JSON 编辑框或少了说明文字，已存的操作内容和服务端校验都不受影响，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `ActionDefaultInspector` (the action designer, mounted by the full-page editor and by the Studio object's Actions view) reads a new optional `serverForm` prop on `MetadataDefaultInspectorProps` and draws the `refusals` and `texts` rows from their served rows: a one-section `SchemaForm` over the served schema, with the row descriptors taken from the served `action` form (`servedFormRows`), placed in the Behavior section beside the script body. The rows bring the key-only record control, their entry rows and help text, and their own `visibleWhen` (script actions only). Both keys are then hidden from "More fields"; with no served form (or a form without the row) they stay in "More fields" exactly as before.
- Hosts pass the served form: `ResourceEditPage` (designer branch, `entry?.form`) and `StudioDesignSurface` (a `typeForms` index beside `typeSchemas`, handed to `ObjectActionsPanel` as `actionForm`, then to the inspector as `serverForm`).
- The inspector now mounts two whole-draft forms, so their inline-issue rows go through the existing `useIssuePrefixRegister` union instead of one form writing the host's callback directly.
- zh-CN overlay (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`): `action` gains `refusals`, `refusals.message`, `refusals.status`, `refusals.reasons`, `refusals.reasons.message`, `refusals.params`, `texts`, `texts.message`, `texts.params`; `hook` gains `texts`, `texts.message`, `texts.params`. Labels copied from the platform bundle `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (labels only, as the overlay's header prescribes for these types).
- No schema or served-form change: `packages/spec` is untouched; the rows on `actionForm` are read as served.

Landing point: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**` and the Studio mount in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**`. `ResourceEditPage.tsx` gains one prop line.

Read first (by risk):
1. `inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` — the `servedRowsForm` block and the hidden-fields change on the fallback form; the two `useWholeDraftFormIssueRows` setters.
2. `inspectors/servedFormRows.ts` — the row lookup (string rows, `{ group }` sections skipped).
3. `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — `typeForms` and the `actionForm` hand-off.

## Tests

- `ResourceEditPage.actionServedRows-35650.test.tsx` (full-page editor, real page with production registrations, type row built from `actionForm` + `ActionSchema` the way the server builds it): no textarea holds either record as JSON; the served help text of both rows is drawn; the key-only control draws `SIGN_IN_REQUIRED` and `email_subject` under their keys; an entry edited through the served row saves, and the saved action passes `ActionSchema.safeParse`.
- `DataPillar.actionServedRows-35650.test.tsx` (Studio design surface: the real Data pillar, Actions tab, with the `action` type row served through `useMetadataTypes`): the same face assertions.

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the inspector)</summary>

Fix committed first; `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` restored to `origin/main` (9348f02b) in the tree only, both pin files run, then `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, proven by blob hash (16b68477 before and after) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- Mutated: 3 of 3 tests red. Both hosts: `expected [ textarea …, …(1) ] to deeply equal []` — the two raw JSON editors holding `refusals` and `texts`, which is the card's premise measured on both hosts. The round-trip test: no `action-served-rows` mount.
- Restored: 3 of 3 green.

</details>

<details><summary>Create page (premise falsified)</summary>

The card lists the create page among the hosts. Measured on this branch with a throwaway render (not committed): the action create page renders the flat `createSchema` form, whose rows are `Label*`, `Name*`, `Object`, `Icon`; it mounts no inspector, draws no `refusals`/`texts` row in any face, and holds no textarea. A new action is named there and authored afterwards in the full-page editor, which this PR fixes. No pin is possible that fails on main, so none is added.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The Studio object's Hooks view (`ObjectHooksPanel` mounting `HookDefaultInspector`) draws the hook's `refusals` and `texts` as raw JSON too: measured on this branch with a throwaway render of the real panel, two textareas holding `{ "CONTRACT_LOCKED": … }` and `{ "follow_up_subject": … }`. The card's "hooks are not affected" holds for the hook's full-page editor only. Same defect class; this PR's `serverForm` prop and `servedFormRows` make it a two-file follow-up (the hook inspector reads `serverForm`, the panel is handed `hookForm`). Reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- `StudioBundleItemEditor` also mounts registered default inspectors, but no action reaches it (`AREA_FORM_EDITOR_TYPES` is `email_template`, `translation`; `dataset` for customize), so it is left unchanged.
